reference_control.reason: CSS Writing Modes 3 section 7.3.1 bounds indefinite orthogonal inline space by the nearest fixed scrollport and ICB. The linked WPT reference available-size-022-ref.html explicitly gives the first five aside boxes 50vh minus margins/padding/borders and the last four 100vh minus the same edges. Chrome 148 ignores the scrollport constraint under containment. These declarations use the independent WPT reference formulas while preserving the test DOM and all ancestor constraints.
reference_control.stylesheet:
aside { height: calc(100vh - 12em - 8px) !important; }
.fixed aside, .fixed-parent aside, .min-fixed-parent aside, .max-parent aside, .min-max-parent aside { height: calc(50vh - 12em - 8px) !important; }
